name: Robert Bresnahan
bio: a Representative from Pennsylvania; born in Kingston, Luzerne County, Pa., April 22, 1990; graduated from Wyoming Seminary, Kingston, Pa., 2008; B.S., University of Scranton, Scranton, Pa., 2012; business executive; real estate developer; member of the Pennsylvania Republican state committee, 2018-2022; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
